alate: Coloration and morphology very similar to the preceding species, differing in the head and pronotum being shorter and narrower.
distribution: In China widely distributed in the southern provinces and in Hong Kong; abroad it occurs in Vietnam.
soldier: Major soldier: head deep yellow, abdomen paler, mandibles black; head and pronotum with a few erect hairs, the abdominal dorsum with few hairs and the venter with more. Head rectangular, widest in the posterior part or at the middle, only the anterior end slightly narrowed; fontanelle very small, situated near the midpoint of the head; head dorsum fairly flat, sloping gradually forwards and downwards from the fontanelle. Mandibles sickle-shaped, labrum ligulate, with a transparent triangular area at the tip; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 longer than or equal to segment 2, a pale eye spot below and behind the antennal socket. Thorax and legs as in the preceding species. Minor soldier markedly smaller and slightly paler; head oval, the lateral margins more curved than in the major soldier, the posterolateral corners rounded; mandibles relatively longer, appearing slender and straight; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than or equal to segment 3; otherwise similar to the major soldier.
